visual.name: siftCalendar
visual.description: Calendar Heatmap visual with 8 layouts, 6 colour modes, date range dragging, presets, drilldown, themes, contrast snapping, and plain-English insights.

dataRoles.name: date
dataRoles.description: Date or DateTime column for the calendar days.

dataRoles.name: hour
dataRoles.description: Optional hour column (0-23) for hourly drilldown and Weekday x Hour layout.

dataRoles.name: value
dataRoles.description: Primary metric value that determines heat intensity and cell values.

dataRoles.name: target
dataRoles.description: Optional target metric for attainment calculation and On Target colour mode.

dataRoles.name: budget
dataRoles.description: Optional budget metric for variance calculation and Vs Budget colour mode.

dataRoles.name: compare
dataRoles.description: Optional comparison measure (e.g. Previous Year) for YoY % and Vs Last Year colour mode.

dataRoles.name: holidays
dataRoles.description: Optional holiday name column to badge special events and public holidays.

dataRoles.name: category
dataRoles.description: Optional category column for small multiples and multi-calendar splits.

dataRoles.name: colorField
dataRoles.description: Optional measure returning a hex colour code per cell.

dataRoles.name: event
dataRoles.description: Optional event name. Days with an event get a marker and the name in the tooltip.

dataRoles.name: sortBy
dataRoles.description: Optional measure that orders the calendars in Small multiples.

dataRoles.name: tooltips
dataRoles.description: Additional measures to show in the hover tooltip card.

layout.description: 8 shapes: Year strip, Month blocks, Months x days, Year over year, Weekday cycle, Weekday x hour, Small multiples, Race playback

enumeration.displayName: Weekday x hour (7 x 24 hourly heatmap)

showEvents.displayName: Mark Days With an Event Label

mode.description: Six ways to colour a day: Amount, Unusual days, In bands, Vs last year, On target, Vs budget

autoContrastText.description: Calculates luminance and snaps text per cell to crisp white or black.

dragSelect.description: Allows clicking and dragging across cells to select a date range.

showPresets.description: Quick date filters: Last 7 days, YTD, MTD, QTD, etc.

allowInvert.description: Toggle between include and invert (exclude) date selection.

enableDrill.description: Drill down through Year -> Quarter -> Month -> Week -> Day -> Hour

showSentence.description: A plain English sentence under the calendar that names what the data found.
